item.title: Why I Don't Need Ceph Storage in Proxmox for My Home Server
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A breakdown of why Ceph can be overkill for home use. Covers the complexity of setup and maintenance, resource costs, and recommendations for simpler and more efficient alternatives for a home server and Proxmox.
